intro: Ecclesiastes is an honest search for meaning in life, by a teacher who had tried everything.
In chapters one and two, he finds that wealth, pleasure and work all pass away, like a breath. Chapters three to eleven weigh up time, wisdom, and how to live well.
Chapter twelve gives his conclusion: remember God while you are young.
Tradition holds that King Solomon wrote it.
Listen for its famous lines: to every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.

card.parts: Ch. 1–2: nothing satisfies | Ch. 3–11: time, wisdom, living well | Ch. 12: remember thy Creator
card.key: A time for everything (3) · Two are better than one (4) · Remember thy Creator (12)
